tokens.name: bg-window
tokens.usage: Opaque window ground. Shows behind the sidebar and assistant only where native vibrancy is unavailable (Linux, Reduce transparency on).

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: The note page and transcript: the content layer. Always opaque, never glass.

tokens.name: bg-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque raised surfaces: cards in the note, settings groups, diff cards, inputs on bg-window.

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: input fields on bg-canvas, code blocks, the transcript search field.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg-canvas, bg-raised, bg-sunken, bg-window and every glass fill.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, sidebar rows at rest, assistant tool-step labels. On every bg-* and glass fill.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, counts, kbd hints, section labels. Meets 4.5:1 on bg-canvas, bg-raised and bg-window in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-4
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for information.

tokens.name: fill-hover
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, ghost buttons and menu items, over any surface.

tokens.name: fill-press
tokens.usage: Pressed and selected-but-unfocused wash; also the resting fill of secondary buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (0.5px on 2x screens, 1px on 1x).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, segmented-control track edge, dragged-item outline. 3:1 is not required: always paired with a fill change.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: In-app floating glass (recorder capsule, toolbars, toasts, Dynamic Island) over backdrop-filter blur(20px) saturate(180%).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Glass that carries reading text: menus, command palette, tooltips, popovers.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Specular top rim of glass (inset 0 1px 0). Gives the material its edge.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Outer 0.5px stroke of glass so it separates from bright or busy content.

tokens.name: material-sidebar
tokens.usage: Tint laid over native window vibrancy for the left sidebar and the assistant panel (macOS glass, Windows Mica).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dim layer behind the command palette and dialogs, with blur(2px).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber, the default accent. Primary button fill, active toggle, selection thumb, record-ready glyph. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover/pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills, both themes (never white).

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text, links, the focus ring and selected icons on bg-canvas, bg-raised, bg-window and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground: active sidebar row, text selection, AI-inserted text in diffs, the selected palette row.

tokens.name: rec
tokens.usage: Recording red: the live dot, stop control, Dynamic Island while recording. Reserved for recording.

tokens.name: rec-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the recording capsule status chip and the "Recording" row in the sidebar.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (always with a check icon): saved, applied, notes ready.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success chips and accepted diff hunks.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions, errors and removed text in diffs (always with an icon or strike-through).

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners, danger buttons at rest and removed diff hunks.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (always with a triangle icon): quota near limit, mic muted, low disk.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning banners.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and links inside banners; scheduled-task proposals.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info banners and the scheduled-review proposal card.

tokens.name: preset-amber
tokens.usage: Accent preset "Amber" swatch in Settings > Appearance. Choosing it regenerates accent, accent-hover, accent-text and accent-soft with hue 62 (formula in Color).

tokens.name: preset-lime
tokens.usage: Accent preset "Lime" swatch in Settings > Appearance. Choosing it regenerates accent, accent-hover, accent-text and accent-soft with hue 128 (formula in Color).

tokens.name: preset-mint

tokens.name: preset-sky

tokens.name: preset-indigo

tokens.name: preset-violet

tokens.name: preset-rose

tokens.name: preset-graphite
tokens.usage: Accent preset "Graphite": a fully monochrome Margin; on-accent flips to bg-canvas.

tokens.name: home-accent
tokens.usage: Home's faces (the empty page). Always the Amber accent, whatever preset is chosen, so the faces keep one look.

tokens.name: home-accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover for home-accent fills.

tokens.name: home-accent-text
tokens.usage: Text and strokes in Home's faces: Amber's accent-text.

tokens.name: home-accent-soft
tokens.usage: Washes in Home's faces: Amber's accent-soft.

tokens.name: on-home-accent
tokens.usage: Text on a home-accent fill.

tokens.name: margin-glow
tokens.usage: Electric blue light under Margin's text box while Margin works (side panel and floating bar). Fixed: it does not follow the accent preset.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and settings page titles, empty-state headline.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Panel headers, card titles, toast titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Summarise the decisions from this call
styles.usage: Default UI text: sidebar rows, menus, buttons, assistant replies.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Secondary UI text, descriptions under settings, tool steps.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, badges, segmented control, tooltip text.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: We agreed to ship the onboarding rework before the pricing change.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, lists and tasks in a note (Sans note font, the default).

styles.name: note-body-serif
styles.sample: We agreed to ship the onboarding rework before the pricing change.
styles.usage: Note body when Settings > Note font is Serif.

styles.name: note-body-mono
styles.sample: We agreed to ship the onboarding rework.
styles.usage: Note body when Note font is Mono; inline code in every note font.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: So the plan is to cut the flow down to three steps.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Recording timer, transcript timestamps, durations. Always tabular.

spacing.note: 4px grid. Half steps exist for optical alignment inside controls only.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-badge nudge, gap inside kbd groups.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked menu items; segmented-control inset.

tokens.name: space-1-5
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding; gap between buttons in a group.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; menu padding; toast padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; sidebar inset from the window edge.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between transcript utterances; dialog body padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between settings groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between note sections; empty-state stack.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Note page side padding at minimum width.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Note page top padding below the title bar.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom runway under the note so the recorder capsule never covers text.

radius.note: Rendered as squircles (continuous corners). Nested shapes are concentric: inner radius = outer radius - inset.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd, checkbox, inline code, diff highlights.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, sidebar rows, palette rows (inside a 12px-padded radius-xl surface: 20 - 12 = 8).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented control thumb.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips (large), toasts, diff cards, cards in a note.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs, the assistant composer, the in-app recorder capsule when expanded.

tokens.name: radius-window
tokens.usage: Window corner on macOS and Linux custom chrome; Windows 11 uses its own 8px.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the recorder capsule, Dynamic Island, toggles, avatar rings.

size.note: Comfortable density. Hit areas never shrink below 28px even when the glyph is 16px.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Sidebar rows, menu items, palette rows, settings rows.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Icon buttons in toolbars, chips, segmented control.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Dialog primary actions, onboarding buttons, the recorder capsule.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Default icon glyph.

tokens.name: size-icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, menu items and 28px buttons.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Unified title bar / toolbar height (traffic lights centred in it).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default left sidebar width (resizable 200-360, snaps at 248).

tokens.name: size-assistant
tokens.usage: Default assistant width (resizable 320-560).

tokens.name: size-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the note column (about 70 characters of note-body).

shadow.note: Two layers each: a tight contact shadow plus a soft ambient one. Dark theme adds a 0.5px light rim because shadows barely read on dark grounds.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons, segmented thumb, toggles' knob.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards in the note, diff cards, settings groups, raised hover of primary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, toasts, the recorder capsule.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Command palette, dialogs, the expanded Dynamic Island.

blur.note: backdrop-filter radii. Never animate blur radius; fade the layer instead.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Floating glass: recorder capsule, toasts, toolbars (with saturate(180%)).

tokens.name: blur-glass-strong
tokens.usage: Menus, palette, popovers: more blur so text on them stays legible.

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind palette and dialogs.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky note header and segmented control.

tokens.name: z-capsule
tokens.usage: In-app recorder capsule.

tokens.name: z-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim, palette, dialogs.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast stack (above dialogs so Undo is always reachable).
